config.text: Turn Image 1 into flat production artwork for vectorisation. Keep the drawing of the two animals exactly as in Image 1: the same fish diving from the top, the same leaping lamb below, the same poses, proportions, positions, outlines, fins, spots, fleece curls and inner cut lines, and the fish's mouth touching the lamb's nose. Change the rendering only: remove the linen cloth, the card, the burgundy paper, the foil shine, the paper texture, the relief and every shadow. The whole image becomes a plain pure white background. The fish is one single flat solid colour, pure blue #1F4FBF, with no gradient and no texture. The lamb is one single flat solid colour, pure green #1E9E5A, with no gradient and no texture. Where the drawing had burgundy cut lines inside the shapes (spots, fin rays, fleece curls, gill line, eyes, hooves), those lines are now white, showing the background. Sharp clean edges like a vector illustration, only three colours in the whole image: white, blue and green. Keep the motif centred in a tall vertical frame. Both eyes are drawn like real animal eyes, as in a natural history engraving, never like a human or cartoon eye: no white highlight dot, no round iris ring, no eyelashes, no eyebrows. The fish's eye is one small solid round dot, cut out in white, with no highlight; its mouth is a long natural closed line following the jaw from the tip of the snout, touching the lamb's nose. The lamb's eye is a real sheep's eye set on the side of the head: a narrow horizontal almond outline with a heavy upper eyelid and a horizontal slit pupil, looking up at the fish.
